preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 400, inclusive.
The number of elements in the set is between 4 and 65536, inclusive, and is a power of 2.
The target sum of bitwise AND operations is between 0 and n-1, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output.count == n/2 and all(a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in output) and all(a_i in range(n) for a_i, b_i in output) and all(b_i in range(n) for a_i, b_i in output) and sum(a_i & b_i for a_i, b_i in output) == k)
postconditions.description: The output is either a list of n/2 pairs of integers, each pair representing a pair of elements from the set, or -1 if no such pairs exist.
